findings.passage: The sanctity of accurate, fair, open, and secure elections is core to our identity as Americans and Virginians.
findings.note: Opening statement of Executive Order 13 (2026), signed by the Governor, on election security and voter-list accuracy.

findings.passage: Over ninety percent of voters in Virginia submit electronic registration applications online through the Department of Elections, which requires a valid Department of Motor Vehicles credential, or submit registration applications when conducting transactions directly with the Department of Motor Vehicles.
findings.note: Executive Order 13 describes online registration as requiring a valid DMV credential, and DMV data sharing with the Department of Elections.
subjects: ID or credential to register to vote

findings.passage: Marked absentee ballots may not be counted until the last four digits of a voter’s social security number and year of birth provided on the envelope are matched to the voter’s record in the statewide voter registration system.
findings.note: Executive Order 13 lists, among procedures the Elections Commissioner must certify (restating Executive Order 35 of 2024), a match of the last four digits of the SSN and birth year on a marked absentee ballot envelope.

findings.motion: Executive Order 13 (2026), Ensuring Secure, Accurate, and Fair Elections: directs annual certification of election security steps, systematic removals of ineligible voters (including non-citizens) finished 90 days before federal elections, and rejoining ERIC
findings.note: Executive order signed by the Governor on 24 March 2026.

findings.passage: I support the intent of this legislation, which is to protect the integrity of our voter rolls by ensuring that voters are not inappropriately or unduly removed.
findings.note: From the Governor's 19 May 2026 release on vetoes, about HB 111 (limits on how registrars cancel voter registrations).
HB 111 would limit cancelling a voter registration to approved state data sources. The Governor vetoed it on 19 May 2026.

findings.motion: On Passage, Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act (documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote in federal elections); House roll call 345
findings.note: As U.S. Representative she was recorded 'No' on passage; the bill passed the House 221-198.
